tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Higher interior derivative estimates] 1. ch2:2.10\group chapter-2 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0035 If $u$ is harmonic in $\Omega $ and $\Omega '\Subset \Omega $, then for every multi-index $\alpha $, \begin{equation} \tag {2.32} \sup _{\Omega '}|D^\alpha u| \leq \left(\frac{n|\alpha |}{d}\right)^{|\alpha |} \sup _\Omega |u|, \qquad d=\dist (\Omega ',\partial \Omega ). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Apply (2.31) successively to derivatives of $u$ on $|\alpha |$ equally spaced nested subdomains.

□
